games.title: 007 First Light
games.description: Earn the Number. 007 First Light is a thrilling espionage action-adventure game from IO Interactive. Follow James Bond as a young, resourceful and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6's training programme, and discover an origin story of the world’s most famous spy.

games.title: Red Dead Redemption 2
games.description: Arthur Morgan and the Van der Linde Gang are outlaws on the run. With federal agents and bounty hunters massing on their heels, the gang must rob, steal, and fight their way across the rugged heartland in order to survive.

games.title: Baldur's Gate 3
games.description: Baldur’s Gate 3 is a story-rich, party-based RPG set in the universe of Dungeons & Dragons, where your choices shape a tale of fellowship and betrayal, survival and sacrifice, and the lure of absolute power.

games.title: Nine Lives Below
games.description: Descend with 1-4 wizard cats through every-pixel-simulated caverns! Craft chaotic modular wands, swat volatile potions off shelves, trigger chain-reaction falling-sand alchemy, and share one pool of 9 Lives in online co-op or solo roguelike runs.

games.title: Haishin
games.description: One night, you casually start a livestream to show viewers around your room. From that night on, your peaceful everyday life begins to fall apart...

games.title: Escape the Baby Alarm
games.description: Parenthood as told through a cozy, psychedelic, puzzle adventure. Solve hand-drawn escape room-inspired puzzles inside a baby alarm. Find your way out through mashed peas, pacifiers and sleepless nights. Funny, heartfelt, and beautifully illustrated.

games.title: BOM BOM BOMBIAN  ～ ボン ボン ボンビアン ～
games.description: Simple controls! BOOOM action! Throw bombs, collect BOM COINs, and become the Bomberhead Champion!

games.title: TWIN FLAMES
games.description: A 2-player co-op puzzle adventure inspired by Savitri and Satyavan. Solve turn-based hex puzzles and guide two separated lovers back to each other across five mythic realms: Sura, Sattva, Swatantra, Satya and Swarga Loka. Online, local or solo.

games.title: Your party died again
games.description: Fight through evil monsters and demons in this Incremental RPG. Collect loot, unlock upgrades and recruit party members to destroy the Demon King. Use abilities strategically or set them to autocast and enjoy the ride.

games.title: 天坑追匪
games.description: A scientific expedition team composed of Chinese and foreign researchers fell into a sinkhole due to an accident, and the entire team mysteriously lost contact. As the captain of the emergency search and rescue mission, you will overcome numerous obstacles and confront the unknown fate head-on
developers: 浙江华智数媒传媒股份有限公司

games.title: Muv-Luv Girls Garden
games.description: The latest Muv-Luv title, with over 800,000 copies sold worldwide! Become an amnesiac commander and lead girls piloting giant humanoid machines called "MGs" in this full-auto idle RPG. Explore the underground abyss known as the Maze and uncover the hidden truth behind the world.

games.title: Late Night Duty
games.description: A short, linear narrative-driven psychological horror walking simulator set in Malaysia. Play as a traumatized veteran on his first night as a school security guard, where routine patrols quickly reveal that something is wrong within the school.

games.title: Loot Nook
games.description: A desktop idle cultivation game. Type to drop gear that auto-equips and powers you up. Cultivate techniques, break through realms, defeat foes for fortuitous encounters, and upgrade your Spirit Tree for better loot — until you transcend the heavenly tribulation and ascend to immortality.

games.title: Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced
games.description: Experience entertainment blockbusters Grand Theft Auto V and Grand Theft Auto Online — now upgraded for a new generation with stunning visuals, faster loading, 3D audio, and more, plus exclusive content for GTA Online players.

games.title: Detroit: Become Human
games.description: Detroit: Become Human puts the destiny of both mankind and androids in your hands, taking you to a near future where machines have become more intelligent than humans. Every choice you make affects the outcome of the game, with one of the most intricately branching narratives ever created.

games.title: The Blood of Dawnwalker
games.description: The Blood of Dawnwalker is an open-world dark fantasy action RPG set in 14th-century Europe. You play as Coen, human by day and vampire by night, fighting to save your family in a story shaped by your actions and the secrets you uncover.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered
games.description: Explore Cyrodiil like never before with stunning new visuals and refined gameplay in The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion™ Remastered.

games.title: Starfield
games.description: Starfield is the first new universe in 25 years from Bethesda Game Studios, the award-winning creators of The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim and Fallout 4.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition
games.description: Winner of more than 200 Game of the Year Awards, The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Special Edition brings the epic fantasy to life in stunning detail. The Special Edition includes the critically acclaimed game and add-ons with all-new features.

games.title: BOMBANANA!
games.description: Chaotic bomb disposal fun with friends & monkeys! Work together as a 3-player co-op team of blind, deaf, and mute monkeys. Each player has only part of the needed information. Communicate, solve puzzles, and race against the clock. Can you defuse the bombs before they explode?

games.title: DOOM: The Dark Ages
games.description: DOOM: The Dark Ages is the prequel to the critically acclaimed DOOM (2016) and DOOM Eternal that tells an epic cinematic story worthy of the DOOM Slayer’s legend. Players will step into the blood-stained boots of the DOOM Slayer, in this never-before-seen dark and sinister medieval war against Hell.

games.title: Fallout 4
games.description: From Bethesda Game Studios, the award-winning creators of Starfield and The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim, comes Fallout 4. A landmark in open-world RPG design and winner of over 200 ‘Best Of’ honors, including the DICE and BAFTA Game of the Year.

games.title: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game
games.description: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game is a fast-paced 1v1 fighter where you battle as your favorite characters from the Avatar franchise. Featuring hand-drawn 2D animation true to the series’ roots, proprietary rollback netcode, and full cross-play for smooth, competitive gameplay.

games.title: The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim VR
games.description: A true, full-length open-world game for VR has arrived from Bethesda Game Studios. Skyrim VR reimagines the complete epic fantasy masterpiece with an unparalleled sense of scale, depth, and immersion. Skyrim VR also includes all official add-ons.

games.title: Divinity: Original Sin 2 - Definitive Edition
games.description: The critically acclaimed RPG that raised the bar, from the creators of Baldur's Gate 3. Gather your party. Master deep, tactical combat. Venture as a party of up to four - but know that only one of you will have the chance to become a God.

games.title: Fallout 76
games.description: Twenty-five years after the bombs fall, you and your fellow Vault Dwellers emerge into post-nuclear America. Join millions of players as you explore, build, quest, and triumph in a massive open-world multiplayer adventure.

games.title: Indiana Jones and the Great Circle
games.description: Uncover one of history’s greatest mysteries in a first-person, single-player adventure. The year is 1937, sinister forces are scouring the globe for the secret to an ancient power connected to the Great Circle, and only one person can stop them - Indiana Jones™.

games.title: Fallout: New Vegas
games.description: Welcome to Vegas. New Vegas. Enjoy your stay!

games.title: Firestone – Idle Clicker Online RPG
games.description: Your heroes never stop fighting. Build an unstoppable team in a fantasy idle RPG with AFK progression and offline rewards. Collect heroes and powerful gear, master formations, defeat epic bosses, and return to bigger rewards and endless incremental growth.

games.title: Bread and Fred
games.description: Grab your best bud for help in this new co-op challenge to help two adorable penguins, Bread and Fred, reach the top of the snowy summit. Time your jumps, cling to walls and swing across gaps to see how far you can make it before you tumble all the way back down the mountain.

games.title: Mark of the Deep
games.description: Mark of the Deep is an epic pirate-themed adventure with a strong narrative and a thrilling mix of Metroidvania and Souls-Like elements. Embark on this journey, explore the mysteries of a cursed island and find your missing pirate crew!
